changelog:
Initial release of Build Legal Services FAQ Page

- Creates customer-facing answers to common legal services questions.
- Designed for legal ops teams, attorneys, and compliance teams working on FAQ content.
- Outlines a clear workflow: clarify requirements, draft answers, enrich with SkillBoss, and refine for delivery.
- Includes SEO-focused keywords (e.g., "FAQ generator AI", "legal workflow AI") and guidance for human review before client use.
- Integrates with chat and web_search APIs for content generation and support.
summary: Generate customer-facing answers for common legal services questions. Use when working on FAQ content for legal ops teams, attorneys, compliance teams.
